description: Explains how electronic excitation opens competing molecular pathways: fluorescence, internal conversion, intersystem crossing, phosphorescence, electron transfer and chemical reactions. Uses Jablonski diagrams, quantum yields, photochromism and time-resolved experiments to distinguish these outcomes.
